parsed.explanation: No law criminalises trans identity or expression; a functioning Supreme Court has protected trans claimants and third-gender self-declaration exists, so state threat-framing (tier 1/c) is absent for a visitor. Resident-facing gaps (cumbersome marker changes, surgical requirements) are climate signals, not traveller exposure, and no border, facility, custody or police-targeting of trans visitors is documented. Against that: documented societal hostility — public-space discrimination, physical and sexual harassment in provincial cities, rising anti-LGBT rhetoric from a governing leader — with thin recourse. Rated as social hostility (tier 3) without state exposure: Reduced Risk, not higher.
